item.title: 0.14.0-beta.2
item.description:
Aki 0.14.0-beta.2

New

  • "+ New" on the marking card: open Claude or Codex in a new Orca tab, or a new conversation in their apps, in the project you pick, with your marks as its first message. No need to open a terminal first.
  • History picks several marks at once with the tick box at the start of each row: send them all to one terminal, mark them done or delete them together.

item.title: 0.14.0-beta.1
item.description:
Aki 0.14.0-beta.1

New

  • "+ New" on the marking card: open Claude or Codex in a new Orca tab, or a new conversation in their apps, in the project you pick, with your marks as its first message. No need to open a terminal first.
  • History picks several marks at once (the tick in place of the number): send them all to one terminal, mark them done or delete them together.

Aki 0.13.0

New

  • Limit resets in the Claude and Codex cards: use one of Codex's right from Aki (it asks first), or go straight to Claude's usage page to use one there.

Fixes

  • With more than one display, only the screen you're on holds still while a hover menu is kept, as with the Mac's ⌘⇧4: the others keep running.
  • A localhost page served from a Claude session's own scratchpad folder goes to that session, whatever its tab is called.
  • Claude's usage ring follows the session that talked to Claude last: after you reset your limit it kept showing the old share.
  • The list of more terminals fits its card: with many sessions its top was cut off.

item.title: 0.13.0-beta.2
item.description:
Aki 0.13.0-beta.2

New

  • Limit resets in the Claude and Codex cards: use one of Codex's right from Aki (it asks first), or go straight to Claude's usage page to use one there.

Fixes

  • With more than one display, only the screen you're on holds still while a hover menu is kept, as with the Mac's ⌘⇧4: the others keep running.
  • A localhost page served from a Claude session's own scratchpad folder goes to that session, whatever its tab is called.
  • Claude's usage ring follows the session that talked to Claude last: after you reset your limit it kept showing the old share.
  • The list of more terminals fits its card: with many sessions its top was cut off.

Aki 0.12.2

Fixes

  • A page's hover menu stays on screen when marking opens, as with the Mac's ⌘⇧4: the screen holds still at once, instead of the menu vanishing and coming back.
  • Claude's usage ring shows the newest share of the limit: a session left idle kept showing an older, lower number.

Aki 0.12.1

Fixed

  • A page's menu that opens on hover (a site's top menu) stays on screen when marking opens, so you can mark it.
  • Sessions in an Orca tab opened recently show the name you gave the tab again (sidebar, History and marks), not the title the agent set.
